observations.text: AC text said '已消耗冲销 409 仍保留'. Independent verification: second reverse returns HTTP 200 with already_reversed=true and msg 库存没有再变动, i.e. idempotent replay protection (api_receipt_lifecycle.py:58-60 explicit success return for status='reversed'), not a 409. Per oracle S2-09 scope (S2-09 is about negative-amount gates, not reversal codes) and the product's own documented intent ('同一张单重复冲销是安全的：第二次直接返回成功'), the protective semantics (no double stock deduction) are preserved and stronger; stock movements verified unchanged across double reverse. Verdict: PASS with documented deviation from the 409 wording; not a defect.

New-manual-entry save path (upload.js validateManualEntry) still hard-rejects total<=0 for credit_note (toast 单据总金额必须大于 0). The defect ticket targeted the positive-total blocker on selected (reopened) credit notes, which is fixed and verified end-to-end in the real browser. The manual-entry entry path is a separate residual gate: a user creating a brand-new credit note by hand cannot save it with a negative total until it has been through the receipt pipeline. Registered for the ticket owner as UX/product follow-up; does not block this card's acceptance criteria.
Playwright version in venv lacks Page.wait_for_response; first UI probe used expect_response context managers instead. Probe-tooling issue only, no product impact.

probe_failures_resolved: First API probe run flagged N1 (double-negative) FAIL: save_edited returned 200 with empty math_blockers. Independent re-verification with the real front-end module in a node vm sandbox shows calculateReceiptIssues returns err_item_num_0 for double-negative credit lines (review_core.js:2944-2946 isQtyPriceInvalid) and submitSaveEdited refuses dispatch at the issue gate (toast 还有 N 处必须先改的地方), matching the AC '双负仍拒' at the user-facing save gate; backend save_edited (api_receipts.py:1412 _math_gate via contract.py:193 _line_value_problem) permits negative_form rows with qty!=0 by design (oracle S2-09 allows qty<0), so a crafted API-only payload can store a double-negative row while no UI path can produce it. Recorded as accepted residual risk consistent with the S2-09 oracle; UI save gate is the enforced boundary.
